id: bigtech:targeted ads delivered 0click exploits to install mercenary :2026-10-15T20:32:41.000Z
title: Targeted ads delivered 0-click exploits to install mercenary malware
author: Dan Goodin
summary_long: Researchers say that mercenary hackers laced ads with zero-click exploits that installed sophisticated malware on the devices of targeted individuals when they did nothing other than load a website or open an installed app. The finding, published Thursday by the University of Toronto’s Citizen Lab, said the incident is likely to be the first confirmation of zero-click mercenary spyware delivered through targeted ads. The attacks, which worked on iOS and Android devices, are particularly pernicious because they work without requiring any interaction from the target and are invisible unless users run special forensic hardware or software. Citizen Lab said it confirmed that AdFection, as it named the campaign, infected 45 devices at international media organization Al Jazeera in 2024 and 2025. Source: arstechnica.com. Date: 2026-10-15. id: bigtech:neutrons first launch slips again amid trouble with carbon c:2026-10-15T16:57:24.000Z
title: Neutron's first launch slips again amid trouble with carbon composites
author: Stephen Clark
summary_long: Rocket Lab announced Wednesday that its Neutron launch vehicle won't fly until 2027, citing an issue discovered during manufacturing of the rocket's carbon composite structures. The announcement was public confirmation of what nearly everyone inside Rocket Lab and the wider space industry already knew. The most recent official update from Rocket Lab in August suggested the company still held hope of delivering the first Neutron rocket to its launch pad at Wallops Island, Virginia, before the end of this year, a schedule that would have almost certainly pushed the first flight into 2027. But Rocket Lab's statement Wednesday about Neutron's schedule suggests the company is still struggling with manufacturing the rocket's large booster stage. Source: arstechnica.com. Date: 2026-10-15. title: 3DCodeVerse: Exploring 3D Worlds as Code
author: Yipeng Gao
summary_long: We introduce 3DCodeVerse, a research ecosystem that enables coding agents to create editable and verifiable 3D content at scale. 3DCodeVerse comprises large-scale, high-quality datasets of executable 3D code, a coding harness for spatial reasoning and automated verification, and practical guidance for 3D coding. First, we construct 3DCodeVerse-2M, a large-scale curated dataset of standalone 3D executable code. We build this corpus by collecting open-source data, converting specialized representations, and generating new programs with coding agents. Source: arxiv.org. Date: 2026-10-15. id: ai_data:a team of gemini 4 argon agents beats minecraft:2026-10-15T17:51:32.000Z
title: A team of Gemini 4 Argon agents beats Minecraft
author: Maxence Faldor
summary_long: We placed four Gemini 4 Argon agents in a sandboxed Minecraft survival world and gave them one goal: defeat the Ender Dragon. Each agent controlled a player via an open-source library called Mineflayer and coordinated with its teammates through in-game chat and shared memory. No one assigned roles or wrote game logic. The agents planned, wrote, and debugged every program themselves. Source: arxiv.org. Date: 2026-10-15. Why it matters: outline likely impact on technology, business, or society. title: Kids are outsmarting social media bans. That’s not a problem we need to solve.
author: Michal Luria, Aliya Bhatia, Danah Boyd
summary_long: Social media bans are stacking up. In July, France joined Australia in restricting minors from accessing social media—barring children under 15 from major platforms, before the ban was blocked by the country’s top court on human rights grounds. The UK aims to forbid kids under 16 from accessing Facebook, TikTok, and other platforms in early 2027, and the EU has announced its own plan to prohibit social media for kids under 15. But early lessons from Australia, which enacted a ban in 2024, show that these sorts of age restrictions are easily circumvented. Source: www.technologyreview.com. Date: 2026-10-16.
